Pathological causes: viral disease - spray insecticide to eliminate aphids/whiteflies as vectors. Insect damage - spray Imidacloprid for aphids/whiteflies; Abamectin for spider mites. Fungal/bacterial disease - use specific fungicides for late blight or bacterial wilt.
